items.difficulty_reason: The main counted unit includes the actual coupled-kernel design via conditioning on y in the next set, verification that the X marginal is P, and joint-history induction. The induction averages Pstar against the pi-restriction law, cancels Q(St,v), derives the volume-biased Kcheck set marginal, and recovers the pi-restriction conditional law by ratio. Treating the kernel design or joint-history law as a free prerequisite would remove the new core; both are included.

target_scope.assumptions: Keep the author irreducible finite-state setting and exact Pstar construction. Do not add laziness/reversibility to17.23 or replace the stated theorem with a different SST claim. Formula17.36 is the exact Kcheck kernel used in the proof.
target_scope.statement: Let P be irreducible and K the associated evolving-set kernel. With Kcheck(A,B)=pi(B)K(A,B)/pi(A), define Jy(A,B)=P_A{S1=B | y in S1}1_{y in B} and Pstar((x,A),(y,B))=P(x,y)Jy(A,B). Starting (X0,S0)=(x,{x}): (i) (St) is Markov with kernel Kcheck; (ii) for w in St, Pstar_x{Xt=w | S0,...,St}=pi(w)/pi(St).
target_scope.core_proof_start: Section17.7: The idea is to start with X0=x and S0={x} and run the Markov chain and evolving-set process together
target_scope.proof_end: QED immediately after which completes the induction step, physical274, before Corollary17.24

Do not silently promote that descriptive absorption language or Corollary17.24 into a separately verified finite-absorption theorem under irreducibility alone.
